metadata.title: Monochrome Portrait with Magenta Accents CD Cover

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition featuring a high-contrast black-and-white portrait of a smiling older man on the right, balanced by bold magenta sans-serif text and a white script signature on a dark background on the left. The bottom left features a blurred perspective of piano keys.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject occupies the right two-thirds of the frame with a direct gaze.
Typography is vertically stacked in the upper left quadrant.
The white script signature acts as a horizontal divider between the title and the piano background.
High-key facial highlights contrast against a deep black background.
coreInvariants: High-contrast monochrome photography for the subject.
Vibrant magenta as the primary accent color for display text.
Presence of a piano keyboard in the lower left foreground.
Tight cropping on the subject's face.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale portrait positioned on the right, cropped at the shoulders and top of the head.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and smile provide the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the magenta title, moves down to the signature, then follows the diagonal of the piano keys toward the subject's face.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black space in the upper left provides a canvas for the primary typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black and white monochrome for the photographic elements.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black background provides high contrast for white and magenta elements.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant magenta (approx. #D81B60) for the main title text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast in the face; high saturation contrast between the magenta text and the grayscale image.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Tight letter spacing to create a block-like appearance for the title.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Modern geometric sans-serif paired with a personal, fluid handwriting script.
graphicDevices: Depth of field blur on the piano keys

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the clean, geometric uppercase look for the title.
Mimics the fluid, connected nature of a signature.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white square photograph. On the right, a close-up portrait of a smiling older man with graying hair. On the bottom left, a set of piano keys receding into the background with a shallow depth of field. The upper left area should be solid black negative space.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three lines of uppercase geometric sans-serif text in vibrant magenta in the upper left. Below that, add a single line of white fluid script text resembling a signature.

verificationChecks: Is the title text vibrant magenta?
Is the signature text white and script-based?
Are the piano keys visible in the lower left?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the individual
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the magenta text is legible against the black.
Confirm the portrait does not look like a specific celebrity.
Check that the piano keys are sufficiently blurred to not distract from the face.
Verify the signature looks hand-written rather than typed.
recipe.reuseFormula: Square layout + Right-aligned monochrome portrait + Left-aligned stacked magenta sans-serif + White script signature overlay.
